skills.description: This skill audits local WorkBuddy memory files for stale, duplicated, contradictory, low-value, or sensitive content, and optionally repairs them after explicit authorization. It should be used for requests such as "memory health check", "检查 memory", "整理记忆", or "清理记忆". Audits are read-only by default; the skill never uploads memory content or modifies service-managed cache files.
skills.description_zh:
本技能用于审查本地 WorkBuddy 记忆文件，检查是否存在过期、重复、相互矛盾、低价值或敏感内容，并在获得明确授权后选择性修复。
适用场景：当用户提出"memory health check"、"检查 memory"、"整理记忆"或"清理记忆"等请求时使用。
安全边界：
审查默认只读，不做任何修改；技能不会上传记忆内容；不会改动服务托管的缓存文件。
skills.name: workbuddy记忆健康医生/memory-health-doctor
